$comment: Downgrade/unknown-format refusal cases for the upgrade rehearsal. Each case is written into an independent fixture home's run/compatibility.json (or storages/ for foreign formats); the rehearsal then launches the real installed app/CLI from the artifact under test and asserts the refusal happens before any data write. 'expectedRefusal' names the observable: cli-exit-5 for the installed CLI, recovery-view for the Desktop admission chain.

cases.description: a legal schema-1 marker written by a newer epoch: the previous candidate must refuse it (its supported epochs are [1]) — the core downgrade refusal
a marker whose schemaVersion is 2: unknown to both artifacts, refused fail-closed
marker bytes that are not valid JSON: corrupt content is refused, never rewritten

a storage document this release cannot classify: the M4 preflight refuses it on the real installed candidate (the marker-only M3 reader is structurally blind to on-disk formats — the delta is the format inspection itself)
a symlink planted INSIDE a per-record storage unit (record file → outside the home): the interior containment walk must refuse it, not adopt the unit envelope and write through the link
